title: Payment Grace for Financed Window Contracts
content:
# Payment Grace for Financed Window Contracts

Window Replacement Contracts. Before late periods are counted on an installed contract, a payment grace is added according to the contract's Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account.

**Rule.** The payment grace is 10 days (the autopay grace days) when the Ridgeline financing account on the contract has autopay enrolled, 5 days (the manual-pay grace days) when the contract has a Ridgeline financing account without autopay, and no grace days when it has none. The grace days are calendar days added to the date from which full 30-day late periods are counted (the late-charge start date).

The account read is the contract's financing account in force (approved, active, delinquent or paid off); a cancelled or charged-off account is never read, and a contract with no account in force has no financing account for this rule.

| Financing account in force on the contract | Autopay | Grace days |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Enrolled | 10 |
| Yes | Not enrolled | 5 |
| None | — | 0 |

## Hypothetical effect

With late periods otherwise counted from 2032-01-20, an account with autopay moves the start to 2032-01-30; a manual-pay account moves it to 2032-01-25.
